notes: Change: a Review card starts with the microphone off; press it to recite aloud, and the next cards keep your choice.
Change: a card's row keeps its buttons in place: leave, again, the end ayah, Skip / Finish / Next card, help, play, more.
New: after a card, help shows what went wrong and the similar passages; play loops the place with Listen's pause.
New: in the car, the start plays the ta'awwudh, the ayah before and, at a surah's start, the surah's name.
Fix: leaving the car pauses its recitation and saves it a minute later; the notification has Pause, Resume and Stop.
Fix: the phone follows a recitation started in the car, with its stop button, instead of staying in Review.
Fix: a double tap on a word now gives Meddeb's own verdict back the second time, never a manual mistake.
New: Stats shows how well Meddeb finds your mistakes (precision, recall), and the chart follows Pace over.
Fix: a corrected slip of a similar passage, and some short added words, are now caught as mistakes.
Change: an empty Repeat box plays once; messages stay long enough to read; the menu is grouped.
